image_record.school_name: Universitas Indonesia
image_record.note: 攝影：Kaliper1 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · The building in the image is the Crystal of Knowledge Library (Perpustakaan Crystal of Knowledge), which serves as the main library of Universitas Indonesia (UI). Located at the Depok Campus, this library is a landmark known for its modern and futuristic architectural design, with angular and geometric shapes that resemble crystals. The building is surrounded by a lake and lush greenery, creating a peaceful academic environment. The library has a futuristic, crystalline shape with a combination of glass, steel, and concrete materials. The large glass windows allow natural light to enter, making it an energy-efficient and eco-friendly. It is one of the largest university libraries in Southeast Asia. Houses a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Includes reading rooms, discussion areas, study lounges, and multimedia rooms. Features high-speed internet access and digital library services. Apart from being a library, it also serves as a venue for seminars, workshops, and exhibitions. Hosts academic and cultural events, supporting both students and researchers. Features an auditorium and event spaces. Built near Kampus UI Lake (Danau UI), providing a tranquil setting for study and research. The surrounding greenery and walkways make it a popular spot for relaxation. The building incorporates eco-friendly designs, including natural lighting and ventilation. Supports UI’s commitment to green campus initiatives. — File:Ui Central Library, Crystal of Knowledge Library.jpg
